parameters.query:
with candidate as materialized (
  select
    ci.content_id,
    ci.title,
    ci.status,
    ci.category,
    ci.source_payload_json,
    coalesce(d.director_json, '{}'::jsonb) as director_json,
    r.render_manifest_json,
    r.render_status,
    r.resolution,
    r.aspect_ratio,
    r.duration_seconds,
    r.cover_image_url,
    coalesce(s.selected_hook, '') as selected_hook,
    coalesce(s.narration_script, '') as narration_script,
    coalesce(s.raw_response_json->'parsed_response'->>'music_direction', s.raw_response_json->>'music_direction', '') as script_music_direction
  from content_items ci
  join renders r on r.content_id = ci.content_id
  left join scripts s on s.content_id = ci.content_id
  left join directors d on d.content_id = ci.content_id
  where ci.status = 'render_manifest_ready'
    and r.render_status = 'manifest_ready'
  order by ci.updated_at asc
  limit 1
), claim as (
  update content_items ci
  set status = 'dispatching_render',
      updated_at = now()
  where ci.content_id = (select content_id from candidate)
    and ci.status = 'render_manifest_ready'
  returning ci.content_id
)
select
  c.content_id,
  c.title,
  c.status,
  c.category,
  c.source_payload_json,
  c.director_json,
  c.render_manifest_json,
  c.render_status,
  c.resolution,
  c.aspect_ratio,
  c.duration_seconds,
  c.cover_image_url,
  c.selected_hook,
  c.narration_script,
  c.script_music_direction
from candidate c
join claim cl on cl.content_id = c.content_id;

nodes.name: Fetch Next Render Manifest Ready Item

parameters.query:
update renders
set render_status = '{{$json.next_render_status_sql}}',
    output_video_url = nullif('{{$json.output_video_url_sql}}', ''),
    cover_image_url = coalesce(nullif('{{$json.cover_image_url_sql}}', ''), cover_image_url),
    duration_seconds = case when {{$json.duration_seconds_sql}} > 0 then {{$json.duration_seconds_sql}} else duration_seconds end,
    resolution = coalesce(nullif('{{$json.resolution_sql}}', ''), resolution),
    render_log = case
      when nullif('{{$json.render_log_sql}}', '') is not null then '{{$json.render_log_sql}}'
      else render_log
    end,
    completed_at = now()
where content_id = '{{$json.content_id_sql}}'::uuid
returning content_id, render_status, output_video_url, cover_image_url, duration_seconds, resolution, completed_at;

update content_items
set status = '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Sync SQL Values"].json["next_content_status_sql"]}}',
    updated_at = now()
where content_id = '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Sync SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid
returning content_id, title, status, updated_at;

insert into workflow_runs (
  content_id,
  workflow_name,
  run_status,
  started_at,
  ended_at,
  duration_ms,
  error_message,
  details_json
)
values (
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Sync SQL Values"].json["content_id_sql"]}}'::uuid,
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Sync SQL Values"].json["workflow_name_sql"]}}',
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Sync SQL Values"].json["next_render_status_sql"] == "success" ? "success" : "failed"}}',
  '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Request"].json["run_started_at"]}}'::timestamptz,
  now(),
  {{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Sync SQL Values"].json["duration_ms_sql"]}},
  nullif('{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Sync SQL Values"].json["error_message_sql"]}}', ''),
  jsonb_build_object(
    'render_sync', '{{$item(0).$node["Prepare Render Sync SQL Values"].json["sync_summary_json_sql"]}}'::jsonb
  )
)
returning run_id, workflow_name, run_status, ended_at;
